cities.name: Far-Post Channel
cities.description: An empty far-post channel under white floodlights; chalk arcs fade into wet turf while the stand shadows hold a quiet finishing lane.

cities.name: Box-Run Lane
cities.description: A diagonal run lane cuts toward the six-yard paint; floodlight haze hangs over deep green pitch with no crowd in frame.

cities.name: Finishing Arc
cities.description: The finishing arc just outside the box glows under gold flood spill; goalmouth empty, netting still, legacy waiting.

cities.name: Tempo Circle
cities.description: Centre circle on wet night turf; soft floodlight rings catch dew while the midfield hush holds the match's tempo.

cities.name: Switch of Play
cities.description: A wide switch lane across the half; chalk and grass texture stretch toward the far touchline under cool white lights.

cities.name: Press Trap
cities.description: A compressed midfield pocket where press traps form; empty pitch geometry, clay terrace glow in the distance.

cities.name: Set-Piece Wall
cities.description: An empty set-piece wall line painted in chalk before the box; floodlights bleach the paint while the goal waits.

cities.name: Six-Yard Chaos
cities.description: Six-yard paint under hard white light; scuffed turf and empty netting suggest the chaos that lives here every corner.

cities.name: Penalty Spot
cities.description: A lone penalty spot on night turf; clay seating bands frame the box while floodlight gold softens the edges.

cities.name: High Line
cities.description: A high defensive line chalked across the defensive third; empty space behind, floodlit and tense.

cities.name: Last Ditch
cities.description: The last-ditch recovery lane toward goal; wet turf sheen and cool steel-blue night light along the byline.

cities.name: Keeper's Claim
cities.description: The keeper's claim zone — empty six-yard box, gloves imaginary, netting quiet under floodlights.
